# IFMA - International Facility Management Association

> IFMA is the world's largest facility management association, connecting professionals through membership, networking, credentials, and advocacy to advance the facility management industry.

IFMA serves facility managers globally with headquarters in Houston, TX and a regional presence in Brussels, Belgium. The organization offers individual and group memberships, professional certifications (CFM, FMP, SFP), networking communities, and industry resources through FMJ Magazine and digital platforms.

## Membership

- [Join IFMA](https://my.ifma.org/individualmemberjoin): Individual membership registration and account creation for IFMA
- [Benefits of Membership](https://www.ifma.org/membership/benefits-of-membership): IFMA membership benefits including FMJ Magazine, networking, and mentoring
- [Group Membership](https://www.ifma.org/membership/group-membership): Group membership options, pricing tiers, and team development programs
- [Membership FAQ](https://www.ifma.org/membership/member-faq): FAQ covering membership costs, types, benefits, and credential information

## Networking & Communities

- [Networking Groups](https://www.ifma.org/membership/networks/networking-groups): IFMA chapters, councils, and communities for professional networking
- [Local Chapters](https://www.ifma.org/membership/networks/local-chapter-map): Interactive map of IFMA local chapters for facility management professionals
- [Industry Councils](https://www.ifma.org/membership/networks/industry-councils): IFMA industry councils for sector-specific facility management networking
- [Communities of Practice](https://www.ifma.org/membership/networks/communities-old): IFMA communities of practice including Business, IT, and Military groups
- [Young Professionals Network](https://engage.ifma.org/yp/home): Young Professionals Network for career development and FM networking
- [Military Community](https://military.ifma.org): Military community for veterans transitioning to facility management careers

## About & Leadership

- [About IFMA](https://www.ifma.org/about/about-ifma): IFMA's mission, governance, and role as the largest facility management association
- [Advocacy & Government Affairs](https://www.ifma.org/about/advocacy-government-affairs): IFMA's advocacy initiatives and government relations on FM policy issues

## Community Hub & Engagement

- [IFMA Community Hub](https://engage.ifma.org/home): IFMA community hub with events, credentials, and professional resources

## Regional Presence

- [IFMA EMEA](http://emea.ifma.org): IFMA regional hub for Europe, Middle East, and Africa facility management

## Support & Contact

- [Contact IFMA](https://www.ifma.org/about/contact-us): Contact IFMA offices in Houston, TX and Brussels, Belgium for support
